owner_decision: On 2026-11-06 the owner accepted declared hypotheses for unobserved geometry, provided each one is tagged, shown in a distinct colour and never claimed as measured.
rule: Nothing in this register is a measurement. A hypothesis is retired only by the evidence named in 'retire_with'. The scorecard's twin->scan 'inferred' area is the geometric footprint of these entries.

items.region: fin roots and the deep floor of every fin gap
items.how: winding-number 0.5 iso-surface of the open scan; the scanner never saw these surfaces (the 87 boundary loops of 20 mm or more hold 67% of open edges, mostly here)
items.retire_with: CT of the specimen, a rescan with fin-gap coverage, or a supplier drawing of the fin roots

items.region: four head-stud through passages parallel to the bore axis
items.how: interior walls are mostly unobserved; v0 keeps the winding-number closure; v1 replaces it with straight analytic bores fitted on the observed deck notches and cam-side openings
items.retire_with: measured passage diameter and axis at both ends on the specimen or a drawing

items.region: threaded holes under the 10 removed studs (6 cam-side, 2 per flange)
items.how: studs are hardware and are removed; their seats are capped by the closure. A tapped hole (thread class, depth) is not observable from the surface
items.retire_with: stud specification and tapped-hole depth from a drawing or measurement

items.region: intake and exhaust port walls beyond the depth the scanner reached, valve-guide bosses inside the ports
items.how: winding-number closure; v1 lofts the ports through observed cross-sections only and marks the interpolated span
items.retire_with: port moulds, CT, or a borescope survey with registered sections

items.region: valve seat inserts, guide bores and their interference fits
items.how: the twin is the head body only; seat/guide geometry, materials and fits are unknown
items.retire_with: supplier valvetrain specification for this head variant

items.how: observed bore openings are kept as scanned; thread form and depth are not modelled

items.region: any oil or breather passage not open to the scanned surface
items.how: none is invented; the twin contains no internal gallery

items.region: 4 mm inclined rod-like protrusion on the cam side (about x=-19, y=-88)
items.how: it does not pass the stud test (axis inclined 36 degrees to the bore axis, protrudes 10 mm), so it is kept as head body and flagged
items.retire_with: photograph or drawing identifying the feature
